project.title: Activated sludge and influent from Danish wastewater treatment plants
project.description: Microbial core communities in activated sludge plants are strongly affected by immigration and geography. This project encompasses Illumina 16S rRNA gene amplicon data from activated sludge and influent from >80 Danish wastewater treatment plants.
